core_obligations: Form the product covering from the two given coverings and observe that it refines both of them (proof lines 9096-9098).
Write down the two-commutative diagram of categories of descent data and invoke the stated commutativity (proof lines 9099-9108).
Reduce to fully faithfulness of the two legs separately and apply the single-covering refinement lemma (proof lines 9109-9114).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the single-covering case (proof lines 9109-9114).
difficulty_reason: For two fpqc coverings of a scheme S with the first a refinement of the second, the lemma shows that pulling descent data back along the refinement is fully faithful, and consequently that schemes over S embed as a full subcategory of the descent data for any fpqc covering (statement lines 9074-9093). The proof introduces the product covering built from the two given ones, notes that it refines both, and uses the resulting two-commutative diagram of categories of descent data whose commutativity is a previous lemma (proof lines 9095-9108). It then reduces to the fully faithfulness of the two legs separately, each of which is the refinement statement for a covering and its refinement (proof lines 9109-9114). The claim is H2: the content is the choice of the intermediate product covering and the reduction to the single-covering case, both written out.
